$comment: Seconds of test time per accessibility contract spec file and per test (file and title path), from a release check's contract legs (four workers). They balance the release shards, where a missing or stale entry never drops or repeats a test. They also plan the pull-request contract job: a file starts there only when its recorded time fits the job's budget, and a file that does not fit is reported as not run. A missing entry counts as the median file. Regenerate with: node .github/scripts/a11y-contract-shard.mjs record <leg logs>…
source: recorded contract leg logs (median of three release checks)
